chat_history.content: Find me 5 differentiated 340B compliance and consulting firms serving hospital covered entities, especially DSH, critical access and rural hospitals. Prioritize firms with diversified service lines such as 340B audits, HRSA audit preparation, split-billing support, state 340B reporting and manufacturer claims data management (340B ESP, Truzo), over firms that rely on claims data submission or the HRSA rebate model alone companies in NCP Priority Geography (Eastern US).

Got it. I know what NCP looks for — founder-owned, differentiated, right to win, growing market, no PE on the cap table. I'll search multiple channels and only bring you companies I'm genuinely excited about (conviction 6+/10). You'll get 5 with investment memos. Give me feedback on each one and I'll learn your preferences.
